name: Gravekeeper Aldous
title: The Silent Terrace
examine: Old enough to have buried the men who buried the men he was named for. He speaks slowly, sweeps carefully, and never, ever discusses the candles.
lines: The stones were here before the kings. They'll be here after. I just keep the moss polite.
Leave the candles be. That's the whole of the rule, and it's not mine to explain.
The Watcher's name wore off before my grandfather's time. The face wore off before that. It still watches. Names are for the living anyway.
